interface_deviations.what: du-gold/1 fact gains three optional fields: quantity_basis, modality, role.
interface_deviations.why: Without a declared modality the oracle cannot distinguish 'a plan restated as actual' from a legitimate actual, and without quantity_basis it cannot catch total-vs-increment paraphrases. Field absence still means unknown and does not trigger review.
interface_deviations.impact_on_others: none; additive and optional, all default to 'unknown'

interface_deviations.what: du-observed/1 is read with selected_text as a first-class replayable field.
interface_deviations.why: A fact carried only by replayed selection text is a real recall, not an omission. This is how the native baseline is scored fairly.
interface_deviations.impact_on_others: none; ROOT adapters may omit it, in which case recall falls back to locator evidence

interface_deviations.what: evaluate() returns extra top-level keys: dimensions, not_evaluated, spot_read_list, review.
interface_deviations.why: The card requires per-dimension denominators, an independent-review worklist, and a record of whether a review was actually applied.

interface_deviations.what: New du-review/1 wire for independent semantic review.
interface_deviations.why: The card requires that regex/numeric agreement never auto-proves entailment, while still allowing a real review to move the verdict.
interface_deviations.impact_on_others: none; optional input, absent by default

baseline_findings.detail: only 11 candidates existed and the selector took all 11, yet 9 of 10 gold facts remain absent. The candidate generator never produced those facts, so raising the selection cap cannot fix cn-ir recall.

baseline_findings.finding: holdout-cn-glodon-q1 produced ZERO candidates from 257 units
baseline_findings.detail: The candidate generator returned nothing at all for a real A-share quarterly report, so recall is 0/7 critical by construction rather than by budget.

baseline_findings.finding: holdout-cn-yake-q1 produced only 2 candidates from 369 units
baseline_findings.detail: A sparse A-share quarterly report is almost entirely invisible to the candidate generator: 2 selected spans for 13 gold facts. Note this document also has 'other significant matters: not applicable' and no business narrative, so it is a genuine low-density document rather than a parsing failure.

baseline_findings.finding: holdout-hk-alibaba-fy2023 has the widest candidate gap measured
baseline_findings.detail: 2,221 candidates from 18,038 units (360 pages) and the 96-span cap selected none of the 14 gold facts, including the 7-vs-6-segment distinction and the segment/market revenue figures.

baseline_findings.finding: cn-ipo-confirmation reproduces the documented title trap exactly
baseline_findings.detail: The one-page scanned confirmation opinion is routed to document_kind=prospectus by the title regex, yields 0 units and 0 candidates, and its single page is reported opaque. This is the failure ROOT predicted, now measured.

baseline_findings.finding: the 96-span cap is only partially binding
baseline_findings.detail: cn-equity (96/449) and hk-annual (96/254) and holdout-hk-alibaba (96/2221) hit the cap with selector_status=partial; cn-ir (11/11), cn-q-business (28/28), holdout-cn-yake (2/2) and holdout-cn-glodon (0/0) did not. So a cap increase would help some documents and none of the ones with zero candidates.

The oracle detects quantity-unit mismatches, basis contradictions, subject swaps and lifecycle-stage advancement from a fixed vocabulary and a tracked-actor list. Paraphrases outside those vocabularies are reported as NOT_EVALUATED rather than guessed, so measured recall is a lower bound on the true defect set.
The tracked-actor list in checkers.py is a fixed vocabulary by design; it will not catch a subject swap between two actors it does not know.
derived_space and time_resource limits are the benchmark's own defaults, not ROOT's production budget; ROOT should pass its real limits.

The 20 survey samples are development seeds, not blind holdout. The 5 holdout records were authored from originals never used to tune rules, which is the strongest claim available here, but they are not a random sample.

holdout-us-* gold facts were authored from an independent subagent's verbatim extraction rather than by this lane reading the HTML directly, because the lane has no HTML text path. The quotes are verbatim but were not re-read page by page here.
cn-annual, cn-ipo, cn-convertible, cn-ir-policy, cn-q-sparse-adjacent survey samples and the remaining HK/US survey documents still have no gold.
not_yet_automatically_checkable: Whether a summary sentence is semantically entailed by its cited evidence, unless an independent review is supplied; the result carries spot_read_list for it.
Whether a value is economically correct beyond its unit/period/basis labels (for example whether management's own arithmetic is right).
Whether a table row is complete when the table itself was never extracted.
Whether a bilingual pair is a true translation versus a different fact in the other language lane.
Whether a company plan is realistic; only whether it was stated as a plan or as an accomplished fact.
Chart and figure content, which the baseline never reads and no gold fact asserts.
Whether an unsupported interpretation attached to a correct number is wrong, without a reviewer; this is measured as deterministic-blind by controls.py.
